assay: bulk RNA-seq (Kapa stranded mRNA, HiSeq3000 SE50; Bowtie2 + RSEM; TMM; edgeR) (S4.17.p1)
sample_inclusion: GAS muscle, 3 MI4KO + 3 MI4OE mice (S4.17.p1); GEO: 3 'IRF4 knock out' + 3 'IRF4 overexpression', male, gastrocnemius
exercise_factor: none: the RNA-seq compares genotypes only; no exercised vs sedentary animals were sequenced. Exercise effects in the paper (Irf4 up after training/acute bout, Fig 1a,b; PTG down after acute exercise, Fig S5f,g) are qPCR/western only (S2.1.p1, S2.5.p2).
primary_estimand: Genotype effect in GAS muscle: MI4OE vs MI4KO (results normalized to MI4KO) (S2.5.p1). Not an exercise effect.
planned_contrasts: MI4OE vs MI4KO in GAS (S2.5.p1; paper: 872 DEGs, 312 up / 560 down)
paper_method: edgeR on RSEM expected counts with TMM normalization (S4.17.p1)
